fees.description:
Fee may be charged when reconnecting or reading your meter when you move into a property or change retailer. Includes GST. Fees
may vary.
Additional fees may apply. For more information, please visit the retailers website at agl.com.au/fees

Fee may be charged when disconnecting or reading your meter when you move out of a property or change retailer. Includes GST. Fees
may vary.
Additional fees may apply. For more information, please visit the retailers website at agl.com.au/fees

A paper bill fee may apply for each bill sent by post. Includes GST
Additional fees may apply. For more information, please visit the retailers website at agl.com.au/fees

An over the counter payment fee may apply for payments made in-person at a Post Office. Includes GST
Additional fees may apply. For more information, please visit the retailers website at agl.com.au/fees

electricityContract.terms:
For further information about the terms and conditions applicable to this energy offer, please contact AGL
on 131 245 or visit agl.com.au
electricityContract.variation: This plan also includes variable rates, retail fees and charges, which can change at any time with notice to you. If we vary your rates, we will give you at least 5 business days prior notice of the variation. Other charges may be varied with notice

incentives.eligibility: Free electricity usage up to 24kWhs/day applies from 11am-2pm every day. Daily supply and controlled load charges still apply. This rate can change with notice to you.

eligibility.information: This offer applies to customers with a smart meter and an applicable network tariff. For full eligibility criteria, or for further information about the terms and conditions applicable to this energy offer, please contact AGL on 131 245 or visit agl.com.au.

greenPowerCharges.description: For 1.1c / kWh inc. GST we ensure energy equal to 100% of your usage will be fed into the grid from Accredited GreenPower generators.

electricityContract.onExpiryDescription:
Your market contract is ongoing. From time to time, AGL reviews its offers and this offer will be reviewed
with consideration to AGL's generally available market offers
